Hospital Income Insurance

Hospital Income Insurance is a coverage that provides a daily monetary cash benefit to an insured subject to a deductible limit in case of hospital confinement.

What are the information/documents needed for Hospital Income Insurance?

  • Preferred schedule of benefits (with deductible)
  • Headcount of enrollees
  • Nature of business
  • Broker of Record (BOR) – form will be provided by Trinity
